motion.name: appearance-spring
motion.value: linear() damped spring (ratio 0.8, ~1.5% overshoot), fallback cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.15, 0.5, 1); leading edge 0.36s, trailing 0.46s after 0.02s

materials.name: liquid-glass
materials.value: backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.8) over var(--glass) / var(--glass-strong)
materials.purpose: Toolbar controls, floating panels and modules, the header from 640px. Solid under reduced transparency, increased contrast or no backdrop-filter support.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: macOS 27 alert-style capsule for the main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--foreground, #171a18); color: var(--background, #f1f2ee); font: 600 0.875rem/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground, #171a18); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The alternative action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #171a18) 8%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #171a18); font: 600 0.875rem/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #171a18) 13%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground, #171a18); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Links are underlined text; the underline darkens on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { color: var(--foreground, #171a18); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #171a18) 40%, transparent); text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: text-decoration-color 0.15s; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--foreground, #171a18); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground, #171a18); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Default Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--rec, #9ddeb9); color: #171a18; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Keycap
components.description: A key named in text, like Right ⌥.
components.css: .ds-kbd { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #cfd3cc); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #171a18); font: 0.85em/1.375 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--border, #cfd3cc), 0 1px 0 var(--border, #cfd3cc); }

components.name: Window
components.description: A macOS 27 window mockup: 24px corners, no divider, glass toolbar controls.
components.css: .ds-window { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #171a18); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--window-rim, transparent), 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08), 0 34px 70px -30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), 0 12px 24px -14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.28); } .ds-window-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; height: 52px; padding: 0 20px; font-size: 0.85rem; } .ds-window-bar b { font-weight: 600; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-lights { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-lights i { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff5f57; } .ds-lights i:nth-child(2) { background: #febc2e; } .ds-lights i:nth-child(3) { background: #28c840; } .ds-glass-controls { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--glass, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.56)); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.8); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-rim, #fff), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--glass-edge, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)), 0 6px 16px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-glass-controls svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-window-body { padding: 8px 48px 28px; font-size: 1.1rem; }

components.name: Recording Overlay
components.description: peluni's real overlay: a dark capsule with level bars, dark in both themes.
components.html: Listening…
components.css: .ds-overlay { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1d1d1f; color: #f5f5f7; font: 500 0.8rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25), 0 14px 30px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-bars { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 20px; } .ds-bars i { width: 3px; border-radius: 1px; background: currentColor; animation: ds-wave 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(2n) { animation-delay: -0.2s; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(3n) { animation-delay: -0.45s; } @keyframes ds-wave { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.35); } 50% { transform: scaleY(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-bars i { animation: none; } }

components.name: Marker
components.description: Words peluni put there: a Marker Teal stroke under the text.
components.html: Move the demo to Friday at ten.
components.css: .ds-marker-demo { font: 1.5rem/1.3 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; color: var(--foreground, #171a18); } .ds-marker { background: none; color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--rec, #9ddeb9); text-decoration-thickness: 0.18em; text-underline-offset: -0.08em; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Wordmark left, underlined sans links right; the current page is semibold.
components.html: FeaturesHow it worksFAQ
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 20px; font: 0.95rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--foreground, #171a18); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--border, #cfd3cc); text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: text-decoration-color 0.15s; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { text-decoration-color: var(--foreground, #171a18); } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground, #171a18); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Consent Panel
components.description: A floating glass panel with capsule buttons.
components.html: Allow analytics? Off unless you allow it.
components.css: .ds-panel { max-width: 28rem; padding: 20px; border-radius: 28px; background: var(--glass-strong, rgb(246 247 243 / 0.93)); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.8); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-rim, #fff), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--glass-edge, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)), 0 28px 56px -24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); font: 0.875rem/1.6 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground, #171a18); } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; } .ds-panel div { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-panel button { flex: 1; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-p1 { background: var(--foreground, #171a18); color: var(--background, #f1f2ee); } .ds-p2 { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #171a18) 8%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #171a18); } .ds-panel button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground, #171a18); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Appearance Switch
components.description: macOS Appearance (Auto, Light, Dark) as a segmented control with a spring-stretch thumb.
components.html: Appearance
components.css: .ds-appearance { position: relative; display: flex; height: 44px; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #171a18) 6%, transparent); --i: 0; } .ds-appearance:has(label:nth-of-type(2) input:checked) { --i: 1; } .ds-appearance:has(label:nth-of-type(3) input:checked) { --i: 2; } .ds-appearance legend { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); } .ds-thumb { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: calc(4px + var(--i) * 44px); right: calc(4px + (2 - var(--i)) * 44px); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--thumb, #fff); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-rim, #fff), 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08), 0 2px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22); transition: left 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.3, 0.5, 1), right 0.34s cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.3, 0.5, 1); } .ds-appearance label { position: relative; display: flex; width: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #171a18) 60%, transparent); cursor: pointer; } .ds-appearance label:has(input:checked) { color: var(--foreground, #171a18); } .ds-appearance label:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground, #171a18); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-appearance input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-appearance svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-thumb { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is a desk: grey-green paper, green-black ink, text set in a serif at reading size, sections divided by a rule or by space and never by a box. On that desk sit a few macOS windows, and they are the only things that lift off it. Each window shows peluni doing its one job (Reminders mid-dictation, the Vocabulary tab, a Messages reply with Wi-Fi off). The contrast between flat paper and real window is the whole idea: the page is the explanation, the windows are the evidence.

Density is low and the reading column is narrow (42rem). Sections take the form their content needs: a ruled table for cleanup levels, a window beside a sentence for vocabulary, one dark band for the privacy claim, a numbered list for building it. The interface parts (buttons, chips, the header) are plain and native: macOS 27 capsule buttons and real window chrome, nothing styled beyond what the platform does.

The windows follow macOS 27: 24px corners, no title-bar divider, traffic lights inset, and subtle Liquid Glass on what macOS puts it on (toolbar controls, floating panels and modules, the navigation layer). Glass belongs to the windows and the layer above the page, never to the paper.
keyCharacteristics: Flat paper, lifted windows. Only windows and what floats above the page cast a shadow.
One accent, Marker Teal, used as a fill or a stroke, never as text.
Three typefaces with fixed jobs: serif to read, sans for the interface, mono for transcripts.
Light and dark are equal citizens. Dark is charcoal, not black.
Motion only where the product is working: the waveform, the caret, the record light, the demo loop.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Marker Teal is the only color with a meaning. A new colored element needs a reason the existing ones don't cover.

rules.name: The Ink Never Fades Rule
rules.body: Paragraphs are full Ink. Muted Ink is for labels of a few words.

rules.name: The Equal Themes Rule
rules.body: Every token has a dark value, and every text pair reaches 4.5:1 in both themes (tested).

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings are sentence case at weight 600, balanced with `text-wrap: balance`. No italic accent word, no eyebrow above, no all-caps label.

rules.name: The Lowercase Name Rule
rules.body: "peluni" is lowercase everywhere, including at the start of a heading.

rules.name: The Only Windows Lift Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this is a macOS window, or it floats above the page". If it isn't one, it is flat.

rules.name: The Glass Is Platform Rule
rules.body: Glass appears only where macOS puts it, and only as much as macOS shows. If it draws attention to itself, there is too much. The recording overlay stays solid, because the real one is.

dos: Do keep body text full Ink at 1.1875rem or more, in a column of 42rem at most.
Do use Marker Teal as a fill or stroke for something peluni did, and nowhere else.
Do build window chrome from `WindowChrome.tsx`: 24px corners, no divider, inset traffic lights, the Window shadow and a label.
Do check mockups against the app's source (tab names, labels like `sounds like: pell oony`).
Do stop every looping animation under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
Do check light, dark, 390px and reduced motion before calling a visual change done.
Do keep Liquid Glass to toolbar controls, floating panels and modules, and the sticky header, with the solid fallback for reduced transparency and increased contrast.
donts: Don't use gradients, gradient text, glow blobs, mesh or noise backgrounds, or colored shadows.
Don't add eyebrow labels, hero pill badges, trust-chip rows, icon-card grids, bento grids, section numbers, a final CTA band or a giant footer wordmark.
Don't put a card or shadow on anything that isn't a window or a floating panel.
Don't use capsules outside macOS parts; no pill labels or badges.
Don't put glass on paper, a section, or the phone header where nothing scrolls under it.
Don't fade sections up on scroll, add marquees or lift things on hover.
Don't put glass on the recording overlay; the real one is solid.
Don't redraw, recolor or relock the logomark and wordmark.
